en.title: Maximum Even Sum of a Possibly Empty Subset
en.description:
Choose any number of items from an integer array so that their sum is even and as large as possible; choosing no items is allowed. There is at least one even element, and elements may be negative.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n, and the second line contains the array. The source gives no numeric bounds; on this site 1≤n≤200000, −10^9≤element≤10^9, and there is at least one even number.
en.explanation: The examples give 22, 0 and 4 respectively; negative numbers do not have to be chosen.
hints: Maintain the maximum even sum and the maximum odd sum achievable over the processed prefix, and for each item choose whether to skip or take it.
